info.name: Get Open Access Status by DOI

params.name: email
params.description: Your email address — required for all API calls to identify usage

items.docs: Retrieve open access information for a scholarly article identified by its DOI. Returns the OA status, best open access location, all available OA locations, journal metadata, and author information.

params.name: query
params.description: Title search query. Supports AND (default), OR, phrase matching ("exact phrase"), and negation (-term).

params.name: email
params.description: Your email address — required for all API calls

params.name: is_oa
params.description: Filter results to open access articles only (true) or closed access only (false)

params.name: page
params.description: Pagination page number (50 results per page)

items.docs: Search the Unpaywall database by article title. Returns up to 50 matching articles per page with relevance scores and title snippets. Covers 120M+ articles with Crossref DOIs updated within 24 hours. Supports AND logic (default), phrase matching (quoted), OR operator, and negation (-term).
